title: Trump Warned of a Depression, Here’s What the Options Actually Price
speaker: tastylive host (Options Math Check)

macro_themes.view: Midterm year is the weakest; the following period from January is historically the best; gridlock good for stocks.
Options and VIX contango price no depression or even a 10% decline.

calls.reason: Post-midterm period historically strongest and S&P rallied through 21 of 23 midterms; options imply ~423-point move to January, no crash priced.
calls.quote: It just so happens that we're currently in a bad period. The good one begins in January.

notes: Medium-term bullish is inferred from cited seasonality stats, not an explicit host call; low conviction. VIX ~15 in contango.
